The proposed strategies and best practices can be easily adapted and applied to real-world scenarios, making them highly useful for improving communication and collaboration within global teams.

Flexibility: 4

The solution also demonstrates a deep understanding of the challenges faced by global teams and provides a detailed roadmap for addressing these challenges.
